description: Annual financial statements for a Romanian company from Ministry of Finance filings, every fiscal year on record since 2008: revenue, profit, headcount and balance-sheet lines in RON with each year's ratios (growth, margins, equity ratio, liquidity), plus a summary (3/5/10-year CAGR, loss years, health score). Resolve the company with lookup_business first if you only have a name.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

name: lookup_financials

outputSchema.description: Every annual filing on record for the company, newest first (RON).

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

found.description: Whether any filing is on record.

source.description: Data source: onrc (registry) or mfp (Ministry of Finance filings).

summary.description: History, revenue growth (3/5/10-year CAGR), latest ratios, health score and band, flags.

years.description: Per fiscal year: revenue, profit, loss, netResult, employees, assets, debt, equity (RON) and that year's ratios.

title: Annual financial statements
